figure.label: Sensitive dependence in the Lorenz system
figure.legend: Live: the Lorenz system (σ = 10, ρ = 28, β = 8/3). Particles are born in a cloud about 0.002 across at one point of the attractor and spread over all of it within about ten time units, since nearby states separate at the rate λ₁ ≈ 0.91.
